status.wilted: Oh no — {{name}} has wilted. Keep it watered and it will bounce back.
status.tapWaterWarning: Tap water works in a pinch, but the limescale costs a little health.

onboarding.welcome: A tiny Venus flytrap has moved in on your windowsill. It needs light, rainwater — and the occasional fly.
onboarding.tip1: Water it from the rain barrel. Tap water works, but the limescale hurts.
onboarding.tip2: Each trap can only snap a few times before it withers — a new one grows back.
onboarding.tip3: Catching insects is a tasty bonus. Light and water are what keep it alive.

scene.hintSnap: Tap a trap when an insect is close — snap!
